column1: # What CoreLib's native methods can do to their callers, read from the pinned runtime source.
# Every native a row names runs no managed code.
#   kind     FCall (an InternalCall, named Namespace.Type::Method) or QCall (named by its entry point)
#   raises   the CoreLib exception types it can raise, by full name, separated by |; - for none
#   result   none (not a reference), nonnull, or maybenull
#   sources  path:symbol under src/coreclr, separated by |, the function it is bound to first

column7: Reads the current thread's managed ID.

Allocates a string, by RhNewString or (when allocations are tracked) RhpNewVariableSizeObject, each of which throws OutOfMemoryException when allocating fails or the length, read unsigned, exceeds the longest a string can be.
Reads the element type from the type handle.
Zeroes memory; an invalid address faults in native code, which ends the process.
Allocates the current thread's Thread object on first use, initialising its fields without running a constructor.
Allocates the type's RuntimeType object on first use, setting its fields without running a constructor.
Loads a resource string, falling back to a constant one, and allocates it.
